global_notes: The matrix is empty at creation. Coverage values are recorded only when actual evidence is available. No coverage is invented.
Agent B does not implement code. Agent A implements code, tests, and the persistence rotation. Agent B records the matrix structure and the evidence as it is collected.
The matrix does not validate the financial model. The matrix does not authorize paid pilot. The matrix does not claim external validation.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
